interaction.action: Click the "Add to Bag" button for the first visible product

violation.help: The bag item count updates (badge shows '1', etc.) but there is no visible or announced confirmation of WHAT changed for either sighted or screen-reader users. A Toast component now exists at src/components/Toast.jsx, wired into the Redux store as state.toast ({ message, visible }) via toastActions.showToast(message) / toastActions.hideToast() from src/store/toastSlice.js, and rendered globally in App.jsx. It already has role='status' and aria-live='polite', so any message dispatched through it is both visible AND announced to assistive tech automatically -- you do not need to add any other aria-live yourself.
